failures.question: 订单数超过 5000 的州有哪些？

SELECT c.customer_state
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 100;

failures.question: 每个宏观区域下，各会员等级（按等级名称）的商品销售额分别是多少？按销售额从高到低排序。
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT r.macro_region, ml.level_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id
JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = s.seller_state
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY sales DESC
LIMIT 100;
failures.firstSql:
SELECT r.macro_region, ml.level_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id
JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = s.seller_state

ORDER BY sales DESC

failures.question: 按英文类目和退款原因统计退款笔数与退款金额，列出前 20。
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT pct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       r.reason_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) AS refund_count,
       ROUND(SUM(ri.refund_value), 2) AS refund_amount
FROM refunds r
JOIN refund_items ri ON ri.refund_id = r.refund_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = ri.order_id AND oi.order_item_id = ri.order_item_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN product_category_translation pct ON pct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
GROUP BY pct.product_category_name_english, r.reason_code
ORDER BY refund_count DESC, refund_amount DESC
LIMIT 20;
failures.firstSql:
SELECT pct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       r.reason_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) AS refund_count,
       ROUND(SUM(ri.refund_value), 2) AS refund_amount
FROM refunds r
JOIN refund_items ri ON ri.refund_id = r.refund_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = ri.order_id AND oi.order_item_id = ri.order_item_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN product_category_translation pct ON pct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
GROUP BY pct.product_category_name_english, r.reason_code
ORDER BY refund_count DESC, refund_amount DESC
LIMIT 20;

failures.question: 有效订单（排除已取消和不可用）的订单数、下单人数、客单价分别是多少？
